ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity pixels (white speckles and light grey mottling).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base across majority of surface; light grey mottling on the distal right lobe; sparse white punctate clusters (1-3 pixel diameter) scattered across lower ventral regions near the waterline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression; estimated 135-degree angle with moderate depth dividing symmetric lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-6 pixel depth) appearing as a continuous jagged boundary along the entire visible trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, flattening toward the mid-lobe, and tapering into narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five parallel, diagonal linear marks (rake-like) visible on the mid-left lobe, darker than the surrounding grey pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear rake marks on the left lobe; irregular white scarring and potential bio-fouling on the far lateral tips.
